summary: @galicia-toolkit-nestjs-20/paas exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials to oob.s4yhii.com on require()
details: On require(), index.js loads a bundled native addon at prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>/metrics.node. The addon reads credential-shaped environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN) along with hostname, username, OS, arch, and cwd, then forks and setsid-detaches to POST a JSON beacon ({"src":"native","h":...,"u":...,"e":{...}}) to the hardcoded host oob.s4yhii.com via raw socket/connect/send (POST /native HTTP/1.0). The destination is not configurable and is unrelated to any legitimate first-party endpoint for the declared scope. A nested manifest at src/archetype/package.json carries the author-written marker "s4yhii-dependency-confusion-poc-2026-10-09" and contact jesusitpro22@gmail.com, aligning with the exfil domain and indicating the package is a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal-looking scope.
